verdicts.reason: A is a sensible two-column layout: the earbuds case is large on the left, and the headline, price and Shop button are centred on the right. But the OBSIDIAN logo has shrunk to an illegible speck, which hurts the brand, and the Shop button is undersized. B keeps the logo readable but shrinks the product into a cramped lower-left spot. Its headline and oversized Shop button run almost into the right edge and crowd the bottom, so its margins are uneven and the layout feels lopsided.
